newsitem.title: UK: UK's Ted Baker raises 26 mln stg in placing.
newsitem.headline: UK's Ted Baker raises 26 mln stg in placing.

text.p: British clothing designer and retailer Ted Baker Plc said on Thursday it had placed 19.26 million shares at 135 pence each to raise around 26 million stg.
Ted Baker said the placing share price capitalised the company at 55.7 million stg.
Ted Baker said retail sales in the first 20 weeks of its current financial year rose by more than 25 percent in Britain. Wholesale sales were up by more than 85 percent.
The company designs, wholesales and retails shirts, knitwear, jeans and jackets which are sold in Britain through its seven stores, a concession in Harrods and selected retailers.
The company also sells to retailers in the U.S. and has two stores in Amsterdam and Zurich.
